summary: Grupo Televisa filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release dated October 29, 2026. Consolidated revenue fell 3.8% to Ps.14,077.7 million, while operating segment income rose 5.6% to Ps.5,996.0 million at a 42.6% margin, up roughly 380 basis points. Net income attributable to stockholders was Ps.882.7 million versus a prior-year loss. Cable and Sky are now reported as a single Telecom segment. A conference call is scheduled for October 30, 2026. This is a routine results announcement, not a special situation; watch subscriber trends and margin sustainability.
